//: MOBILE. The desktop config is the sibling file; this one exists because
CLAUDE.md says a working mobile experience is not optional, and nothing was
measuring it. Lighthouse's mobile preset applies a 4x CPU slowdown and a
slow-4G network on top of a small viewport, which is the closest thing to a
mid-range phone that CI can produce.
The performance floor here is NOT set yet, on purpose. Setting it before the
first measurement would mean either inventing a number or copying the
desktop one, and a threshold picked to be passed is the thing this whole
repository spent a week learning not to write. So this run asserts only the
things that should not depend on the device — accessibility, SEO, layout
shift — and archives the report. The floor goes in on the next push, from
the number the first run actually produced.
